title: Shopify Opens Shop Pay for Use at All Online Retailers

tickers.name: Shopify Inc. Class A subordinate voting shares

summary:
The e-commerce company has updated its payment tool to allow shoppers to complete orders at any web store, including those not utilizing the Shopify platform. This change enables the payment service to be integrated into external developer projects and personal AI assistants, such as Instinct, which can now execute secure purchases on behalf of users by accessing their saved card and address details.

The expansion brings the platform-agnostic checkout experience to Shop Pay's 400 million users. Alongside the payment update, Shopify added a feature to its Shop app allowing users to check out from multiple brands in a single transaction and listed products from non-Shopify merchants within its catalog.

Check out anywhere with Shop Pay

Today, we’re expanding our partnership with @Shopify beyond finding, buying and tracking orders from Shopify stores. Now, your Instinct can use Shop Pay at any online store.

The card and address you've already saved in Shop Pay now work across stores that aren’t on Shopify, too. This makes it easy for your Instinct to make secure purchases on your behalf.

You approve every purchase in Shop Pay, and your card details never leave Shop Pay.
